sources.snippet: The Model That Changed Everything. DeepSeek R1 - the open-source reasoning model that matched OpenAI o1, crushed NVIDIA's stock price, and proved that frontier-level chain-of-thought AI didn't require proprietary infrastructure. Free. MIT licensed. Available to run on your laptop.
